title: A Contact for the Cipher
author: Petra Thornbury
blurb: Oscar Winterbourne, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
